reentry_capsule.current_state: The signed comparison-v0.3.1 release and docs revision ff9a82f78b15b07ab90774032d2ec7a7bfd2bcd1 remain the accepted public baseline. A content-addressed 0.3.2 candidate now receives Enterprise v0.3.2 while preserving the compared result and classification counts.
reentry_capsule.next_safe_action: Review and merge the exact 0.3.2 candidate, assemble release/0.3.2 from accepted develop, and promote it through main before recording the signed release coordinate and rebuilding the docs projection.
reentry_capsule.verification: Confirm the Enterprise v0.3.2 release objects, the single-byte version-string change in the source envelope, unchanged result and projection identities, stable 10/4/3 classification counts, new deterministic report digests, exact candidate receipt, and preserved comparison-v0.3.1 release and Pages coordinates.

retained_effects: The selected future remains definitive only inside its declared simulation reality.
Observed evidence can extend the comparison surface without reopening a coherent simulated closure.
consequential_questions: Which future implementation or assumption change would materially alter the 17-field comparison or warrant a new selected-future closure?
Which observed encounter would create enough decision value to justify its collection cost?
